lines.t: He stays in the background, calm in the room
Faithful through seasons that quietly bloom
No need for applause, no need for a crown
He carries his purpose when no one’s around
His hands may be empty, his heart may be worn
Still he keeps walking through each coming storm
Quiet and ready, faithful and strong
He waits for the moment where he belongs
When heaven speaks, he follows through
With nothing to gain and nothing to prove
Quiet and ready, steady in grace
He keeps his eyes on the Father’s face
No spotlight calling, no banner to raise
Just serving with love through all of his days
He pours out compassion where no one can see
A prayer in the midnight for souls to be free
He lays down his will when the road becomes hard
Trusting the Maker to carry his heart
No pride in his footsteps, no claim to his name
He walks through the fire and stays just the same
Quiet and ready, faithful and strong
He waits for the moment where he belongs
When heaven speaks, he follows through
With nothing to gain and nothing to prove
Quiet and ready, steady in grace
He keeps his eyes on the Father’s face
No spotlight calling, no banner to raise
Just serving with love through all of his days
When the burden is placed and the hour is near
He rises in faith, never ruled by fear
No turning to comfort, no looking behind
Just peace in his spirit and fire in his mind
Hidden… but chosen
Still… but moving
Waiting… for heaven
Called… and obeying
Quiet and ready, faithful and strong
He waits for the moment where he belongs
When heaven speaks, he follows through
With nothing to gain and nothing to prove
Quiet and ready, steady in grace
He keeps his eyes on the Father’s face
No spotlight calling, no banner to raise
Just serving with love through all of his days
A servant in silence, a heart fully known
Led by the voice that has called him His own
